question_en: Movies filmed in Iceland but set somewhere else
question_fr: Des films tournés W Islandii mais dont l’intrigue se déroule ailleurs
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o (gpt-6-sol since 2026-10-01) through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE FROM T_WC_T2S_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION filming_link ON filming_link.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_LOCATION filming_location ON filming_location.ID_LOCATION = filming_link.ID_LOCATION WHERE filming_location.LOCATION_NAME = 'Iceland' AND filming_location.DELETED = 0 AND filming_link.LOCATION_ROLE = 'filming' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION narrative_link JOIN T_WC_T2S_LOCATION narrative_location ON narrative_location.ID_LOCATION = narrative_link.ID_LOCATION WHERE narrative_link.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE AND narrative_link.LOCATION_ROLE = 'narrative' AND narrative_location.DELETED = 0 AND narrative_location.ID_LOCATION != filming_location.ID_LOCATION) ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED DESC LIMIT 15;
